name: ci-cd-pipeline
title: CI/CD Pipeline Workflow
description: Complete CI/CD workflow from commit to production deployment

requirements: Pipeline triggers on push to main and PRs
Run unit, integration, and E2E tests in parallel
Security scan with Trivy and CodeQL
Build and push Docker images on success
acceptance_criteria: False positive rate < 1% for security scans
implementation_notes: Use matrix builds for test parallelization
test_strategy: Chaos engineering: simulate failures at each stage
